question: When an OpenCode agent's `tools` map puts `"*": false` before an allowed MCP tool, does the model request carry only that tool, and does putting `"*": false` after it carry no tools at all?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(any(.messages[]?; .role == "system" and (.content | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-OCDENY7"))))]; def toolset: governed | map([.tools[]?.function.name] | sort) | unique | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" elif length == 1 then .[0] else {inconsistent: .} end; {allow_one: (.allow_one | toolset), reversed: (.reversed | toolset)}
